chapters.name: Babi na 1: Hanyarku zuwa lasisin inshora

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Aikin wakili da nau'in lasisin da kuke buƙata
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Zaɓi nau'in lasisin da ya dace da aikin inshorar da kuke so.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku aikin inshora ko wani nau'in inshora, za ku iya gane wane nau'in lasisi da wane matsayi ne ya dace da shi, kuna samun aƙalla misalai 5 cikin 6 daidai.
Wakilin inshora, wanda doka ke kira producer, yana sayarwa, nema ko tattaunawa kan inshora don abokan ciniki. Kowace jiha tana buƙatar lasisi don yin haka. Captive agent yana sayarwa ga kamfani ɗaya. Independent agent yana sayarwa ga kamfanoni da yawa kuma sau da yawa yana gudanar da ƙaramin kasuwanci. Dole ne kuma kowane kamfanin inshora da wakili ke sayarwa gare shi ya ba shi appointment (amincewa).
Jihohi suna ba da lasisi bisa nau'in iko (line of authority). Manyan nau'o'i huɗu da aka fi sani su ne Life (rai), Accident and Health (haɗari da lafiya ko rashin lafiya), Property (dukiya) da Casualty (alhaki). Mutane da yawa suna farawa da Life da Health tare, ko da Property da Casualty tare. Wasu jihohi kuma suna da ƙaramin lasisin Personal Lines don inshorar gida da mota kaɗai.
Life tana biya idan mutum ya mutu, da wasu inshorori na ajiya na dogon lokaci. Accident and Health tana biyan kuɗin asibiti, kuɗin shiga idan mutum ya kasa aiki saboda rashin lafiya ko rauni (disability), da makamantansu. Property tana biyan lalacewar abubuwan da kuka mallaka, kamar gida ko mota. Casualty tana biyan alhaki (liability), wato kuɗin da kuke bin wani idan kun ji masa rauni ko kun lalata masa kaya.
Sauran ayyukan inshora suna amfani da wani lasisi daban. Adjuster yana bincike da sasanta da'awa. Sayar da wasu kayayyaki irin na zuba jari, kamar variable annuities, yana buƙatar lasisin securities ma. Ku duba jerin nau'o'in lasisi na jiharku kafin ku biya kuɗin kowane kwas.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Producer: kalmar doka ta wakili ko dillalin inshora mai lasisi da ke sayar da inshora.
- Line of authority (nau'in iko): nau'in inshorar da lasisinku ya ba ku izinin sayarwa, kamar Life ko Property.
- Appointment (amincewa): izinin hukuma daga kamfanin inshora don ku sayar da kayayyakinsa.
- Liability (alhaki): kuɗin da doka ta ce kuna bin wani idan kun ji masa rauni ko kun lalata masa dukiya.
- Adjuster: mutumin da ke bincike da sasanta da'awar inshora; yawanci yana da lasisi daban.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta ayyukan inshora uku da za ku iya nema (misali wakilin cibiyar kira da ke sayar da inshorar mota, ma'aikacin banki da ke sayar da inshorar rai, ko naku ofishin inshora). Kusa da kowanne, ku rubuta nau'in lasisi ko nau'o'in da yake buƙata.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin aikin producer na inshora da zaɓar nau'in lasisin da ya dace da wani aiki.

check.q: Tallar aiki ta ce za ku sayar da inshorar mota da ta masu gida. Wane nau'in lasisi ne ya dace?
check.why: Inshorar mota da ta gida tana biyan lalacewar dukiya da alhaki ga wasu, wato Property da Casualty.

options: Wakilin da ke sayarwa ga kamfanin inshora ɗaya kaɗai
Wakilin da ke sasanta da'awa kaɗai
Wakilin da ke aiki ga jiha
check.why: Captive agent yana wakiltar kamfani ɗaya; independent agent yana wakiltar kamfanoni da yawa.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Nemo matakan lasisi na hukuma na jiharku
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Nemo matakan lasisi na jiharku, kamfanin jarabawa da jadawalin jarabawa a shafukan hukuma.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don jiharku, za ku iya nemo matakan lasisi na hukuma, kamfanin jarabawa da jadawalin abin da jarabawar ta ƙunsa, kuna rubuta kowane mataki da adireshin shafinsa na hukuma.
Ofishin inshora na jiharku ne ke yin dokoki. Don ku nemo shi, ku yi amfani da shafin NAIC (National Association of Insurance Commissioners, ƙungiyar masu kula da inshora na jihohi) wanda ke da hanyar haɗi zuwa kowane ofishin jiha. Ku nemi shafukan da ake kira producer licensing, agent licensing ko how to apply.
Yawancin jihohi suna bin hanya iri ɗaya: kwas ɗin kafin lasisi (ana buƙatarsa a jihohi da yawa, ba duka ba), jarabawar jiha da kamfanin jarabawa ke gudanarwa, ɗaukar zanen yatsa ko binciken tarihi, takardar nema, sannan appointment daga kamfanin inshora. Bayan kun sami lasisi, kuna sabunta shi kuma kuna ɗaukar ci gaba da karatu (continuing education). Misali, Texas, lokacin da muka duba a watan Oktoba 2026, tana gudanar da jarabawarta ta Pearson VUE, tana buƙatar zanen yatsa, kuma tana karɓar takardar nema ta Sircon ko NIPR ne kawai bayan kun ci jarabawar.
Kamfanin jarabawa yana fitar da littafin jagora ga masu jarabawa (candidate handbook) da jadawalin abin da jarabawar ta ƙunsa (content outline) don jiharku. Jadawalin yana lissafa kowane batu da yawan tambayoyin da ke fitowa daga kowanne. Shi ne kayan karatu mafi amfani da kuke da shi, kuma kyauta ne.
Idan kuna da tarihin laifi, ku faɗi gaskiya a takardar nema. Wata dokar tarayya (18 U.S.C. 1033) ta ce mutumin da aka yanke masa hukuncin babban laifi (felony) da ya shafi rashin gaskiya ko cin amana yana buƙatar rubutaccen izini daga mai kula da inshora kafin ya yi aikin inshora. Ofishin jiharku yana bayanin yadda ake nema. Kada ku bar mai sayar da kwas ya ce muku hakan ba komai ba ne.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe shafin ofisoshin inshora na jihohi na NAIC ku zaɓi jiharku.
- Ku nemo shafin lasisin producer ko agent da jerin nau'o'in lasisi.
- Ku rubuta kowane mataki: kwas ɗin kafin lasisi, jarabawa, zanen yatsa, takardar nema, appointment.
- Ku nemo sunan kamfanin jarabawa ku sauke littafin jagora da jadawalin jarabawa na kyauta.
- Ku rubuta adireshin shafin hukuma na kowane mataki da ranar da kuka duba shi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- NAIC: National Association of Insurance Commissioners: ƙungiyar masu kula da inshora na jihohi.
- Kwas ɗin kafin lasisi (prelicensing education): kwas da wasu jihohi ke buƙata kafin ku iya ɗaukar jarabawar lasisi.
- Jadawalin jarabawa (content outline): jerin batutuwan jarabawa da yawan tambayoyin da ke fitowa daga kowanne.
- NIPR: National Insurance Producer Registry: shafin intanet da jihohi da yawa ke amfani da shi don neman lasisi da sabunta shi.
- Ci gaba da karatu (continuing education): darussan da wakilai masu lasisi dole su ɗauka don sabunta lasisinsu.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- NAIC: Nemo ofishin inshora na jiharku
- NIPR: National Insurance Producer Registry (neman lasisin wakilin inshora da sabunta shi)
- Texas Department of Insurance: Lasisin wakilan inshora
- Texas Department of Insurance: Yadda ake neman lasisin general lines na rai, haɗari, lafiya da HMO
- 18 U.S.C. 1033 (Cornell Legal Information Institute)
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe shafin NAIC, ku zaɓi jiharku ku nemo shafinta na lasisin producer. Ku rubuta kowane matakin lasisi bi da bi, sunan kamfanin jarabawa, da adireshin shafin jadawalin jarabawa.
Yanzu za ku iya nemo matakan lasisi na hukuma na jiharku, kamfanin jarabawa da jadawalin abin da jarabawar ta ƙunsa.

check.q: A ina za ku sami ainihin matakan lasisi na jiharku?
options: Wani rubutu a kafofin sada zumunta
Shafin hukuma na ofishin inshora na jiharku
Wani abokinku mai lasisi a wata jiha
check.why: Ofishin inshora na kowace jiha ne ke sa dokokin lasisinsa kuma yake fitar da su.

check.q: Wace takarda ta kyauta ce ke faɗa muku batutuwan da ke cikin jarabawar jiharku?
check.why: Jadawalin jarabawa yana lissafa kowane batu da yawan tambayoyin da ke fitowa daga kowanne.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Manyan kalmomi da yadda kwangilar inshora ke aiki
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Bayyana manyan kalmomin inshora da ra'ayoyin kwangila da kalmominku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku jerin kalmomi da ra'ayoyin jarabawa, za ku iya bayanin manyan kalmomin inshora da ƙa'idojin kwangila da kalmomi masu sauƙi, da ma'ana daidai ga aƙalla 8 cikin 10.
Inshora tana ɗauke haɗari daga mutum zuwa kamfanin inshora. Mai inshora (insured) yana biyan premium. A madadin haka, kamfanin inshora (insurer) yana alƙawarin biyan wasu asara. Policy ita ce rubutacciyar kwangila, kuma shafin declarations yana lissafa wanda da abin da aka ba inshora, iyakokin biya da premium.
Jarabawa tana gwada wasu manyan ra'ayoyi kaɗan. Insurable interest: dole ne ku yi asarar kuɗi idan abin ya faru. Indemnity: inshora tana mayar da ku inda kuke a da, ba ta sa ku fi yadda kuke ba. Utmost good faith (cikakken gaskiya): dole ɓangarorin biyu su faɗi gaskiya, don haka ƙarya a takardar nema (misrepresentation) za ta iya soke inshorar. Underwriting: kamfanin inshora yana nazarin haɗarin don ya yanke ko zai karɓa, kuma a wane farashi.
Policy kwangila ce, don haka tana buƙatar tayi da karɓa (offer and acceptance), consideration (premium da alƙawari), ɓangarorin da suka cancanta, da manufa ta halal. Kuma kwangilar adhesion ce: kamfanin inshora ne ya rubuta ta, abokin ciniki kuma ya karɓe ta yadda take, don haka kalmomin da ba su fito sarari ba yawanci ana fassara su don amfanin abokin ciniki.
Ku koyi waɗannan kalmomi da katunan tunawa (flash cards). Jarabawa sau da yawa tana ba da ɗan labari ta tambayi wane ra'ayi ne yake nunawa.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Premium: kuɗin da mai inshora ke biya don samun inshora.
- Insurable interest: samun asarar kuɗi ta gaske idan abin da aka yi wa inshora ya faru.
- Indemnity: biyan asara don ku koma inda kuke a da, ba don ku fi yadda kuke ba.
- Underwriting: nazarin haɗari don yanke ko za a ba shi inshora, kuma a wane farashi.
- Shafin declarations: shafin policy da ke lissafa wanda aka ba inshora, abin da aka ba inshora, iyakoki da premium.
- Kwangilar adhesion: kwangilar da ɓangare ɗaya ya rubuta, ɗayan kuma ya karɓa yadda take.
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi katunan tunawa 10 a takarda ko a waya: gefe ɗaya kalmar (premium, insurable interest, indemnity, underwriting, declarations page, consideration, adhesion, misrepresentation, insured, insurer), ɗayan gefen ma'anarta da kalmominku a layi ɗaya. Ku gwada kanku har ku sami 8 cikin 10.
Yanzu za ku iya bayanin manyan kalmomin inshora da sassan kwangilar inshora da kalmomi masu sauƙi.

check.q: Wani mutum yana son sayen inshorar gobara a gidan wani baƙo. Wane ra'ayi ne ya hana shi?
check.why: Ba zai yi asarar kuɗi ba idan gidan baƙon ya ƙone, don haka ba shi da insurable interest.

check.q: Bayan satar da inshora ta rufe, kamfanin inshora ya biya kuɗin TV ɗin da aka sace, ba babban TV ba. Wane ra'ayi ne wannan?
check.why: Indemnity tana mayar da mai inshora inda yake a da, ba ta sa ya fi yadda yake ba.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Abin da jarabawa ta ƙunsa da shirin jarabawa

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Tushen inshorar rai da lafiya da lissafin da'awar lafiya
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Lissafa wanda zai biya nawa a da'awar lafiya ta gwaji mai deductible da coinsurance.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku jerin kalmomi da ra'ayoyin jarabawa, za ku iya bayanin manyan kalmomin inshora da ƙa'idojin kwangila da kalmomi masu sauƙi, da ma'ana daidai ga aƙalla 8 cikin 10. Idan aka ba ku da'awar gwaji mai deductible, coinsurance ko iyakar inshora, za ku iya lissafin nawa kamfanin inshora zai biya da nawa mai inshora zai biya, daidai har zuwa dala ɗaya a da'awar gwaji 3.
Inshorar rai: term life tana rufe wasu shekaru ƙayyadaddu kuma ba ta da cash value. Inshorar rai ta dindindin (permanent), kamar whole life, za ta iya ɗorewa har ƙarshen rayuwa kuma tana tara cash value. Beneficiary shi ne mutumin da ke karɓar kuɗin mutuwa (death benefit); contingent beneficiary yana karɓa idan na farkon ya riga ya mutu. Mai policy (policyowner) ne ke da iko a kanta, kuma yana iya zama wani daban da wanda aka yi wa inshorar.
Inshorar lafiya tana da nata kalmomi. Deductible shi ne abin da kuke biya kowace shekara kafin inshorar ta fara raba kuɗin da ku. Coinsurance shi ne kason da kuke rabawa bayan haka, kamar 80/20: inshorar tana biyan 80%, ku kuma ku biya 20%. Copay ƙayyadadden adadin dala ne na kowace ziyara. Out-of-pocket maximum shi ne mafi yawan abin da za ku biya a shekara don kulawar da inshora ta rufe.
Don atisaye kawai, lambobin ƙirƙira: kuɗin asibiti $3,000 da inshora ta rufe, deductible $1,000 da ba a biya ba tukuna, coinsurance 80/20. Ku ne kuke biyan $1,000 na farko. Sauran $2,000 ana raba su: inshorar tana biyan 80% ($1,600), ku kuma ku biya 20% ($400). Gaba ɗaya kuna biyan $1,400; inshorar tana biyan $1,600. Dubawa: $1,400 + $1,600 = $3,000.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta adadin kuɗin da inshora ta rufe.
- Ku cire sashen deductible da har yanzu ba a biya ba; mai inshora ne ke biyan wannan sashe.
- Ku raba abin da ya rage bisa kason coinsurance.
- Ku haɗa deductible da coinsurance na mai inshora; ku tsaya a out-of-pocket maximum.
- Ku duba cewa kasonsu biyu sun kai jimillar kuɗin.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Beneficiary: mutumin da ke karɓar kuɗi idan wanda aka yi wa inshora ya mutu.
- Cash value: ajiyar kuɗi da ke taruwa a cikin inshorar rai ta dindindin.
- Deductible: adadin da kuke biya kafin inshora ta fara biya.
- Coinsurance: kason kuɗin da kuke rabawa da inshora bayan deductible.
- Out-of-pocket maximum: mafi yawan abin da kuke biya a shekarar inshora don kulawar da aka rufe.
Gwada yanzu: Don atisaye kawai: ku lissafa wannan da'awa a takarda. Kuɗin asibiti $5,000 da inshora ta rufe, deductible $500 da ba a biya ba tukuna, coinsurance 80/20. Nawa mai inshora zai biya, kuma nawa inshorar za ta biya? (Amsa: mai inshora $500 + $900 = $1,400; inshora $3,600.)
Yanzu za ku iya bayanin manyan kalmomin inshorar rai da lafiya da lissafin da'awar lafiya mai deductible da coinsurance.

check.q: Don atisaye kawai: kuɗin asibiti $2,000 da inshora ta rufe, deductible $500 da ba a biya ba tukuna, coinsurance 80/20. Nawa mai inshora zai biya?
check.why: Deductible $500 tare da 20% na sauran $1,500 ($300) ya zama $800.

check.q: Wace inshorar rai ce ke tara cash value?
check.why: Inshorar dindindin kamar whole life tana tara cash value; term ba ta tarawa.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Tushen inshorar dukiya da alhaki da lissafin da'awar dukiya
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Lissafa abin da inshorar dukiya ko ta alhakin mota za ta biya a da'awar gwaji.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku aikin inshora ko wani nau'in inshora, za ku iya gane wane nau'in lasisi da wane matsayi ne ya dace da shi, kuna samun aƙalla misalai 5 cikin 6 daidai. Idan aka ba ku da'awar gwaji mai deductible, coinsurance ko iyakar inshora, za ku iya lissafin nawa kamfanin inshora zai biya da nawa mai inshora zai biya, daidai har zuwa dala ɗaya a da'awar gwaji 3.
Inshorar dukiya tana biyan lalacewar abubuwan da kuka mallaka. Replacement cost tana biyan kuɗin maye gurbin abin da sabon irinsa. Actual cash value tana biyan replacement cost a cire depreciation (raguwar daraja saboda tsufa da amfani). Don atisaye kawai: kujera (sofa) tana kai $1,200 sabuwa kuma ta rage daraja $500, don haka actual cash value ɗinta $700 ne. Ana cire deductible daga kuɗin da za a biya.
Inshorar Casualty (alhaki) tana biyan wasu idan doka ta ce ku ke da alhakin cutar da su. Ana yawan rubuta iyakokin alhakin mota da lambobi uku, kamar 25/50/25: har $25,000 don raunin mutum ɗaya, har $50,000 don duk raunuka a haɗari ɗaya, da har $25,000 don lalacewar dukiya. Jiharku ce ke sa mafi ƙarancin iyakoki; ku duba su.
Don atisaye kawai: direba mai iyakokin 25/50/25 ya ji wa mutum ɗaya rauni, kuma kuɗin asibitinsa $40,000 ne. Inshorar tana biyan $25,000, iyakarta ta kowane mutum. Direban zai iya biyan sauran $15,000 da kansa. Shi yasa wakilai suke bayanin iyakoki a hankali.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku nemo adadin asarar da nau'in inshorar.
- Don actual cash value, ku cire depreciation daga replacement cost.
- Ku cire deductible.
- Ku kwatanta da iyakar inshora; kamfanin inshora ba ya taɓa biyan fiye da iyakar.
- Duk abin da ya wuce iyakar, mai inshora ne zai biya.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Replacement cost: kuɗin maye gurbin abu da sabo mai irin nau'insa da ingancinsa.
- Actual cash value: replacement cost a cire depreciation.
- Depreciation: raguwar daraja saboda tsufa da amfani.
- Iyakar inshora (policy limit): mafi yawan abin da kamfanin inshora zai biya don asarar da aka rufe.
- Split limits: iyakokin alhakin mota da aka rubuta da lambobi uku, kamar 25/50/25.
Gwada yanzu: Don atisaye kawai: gobara a kicin ta jawo lalacewa ta $18,000 da inshora ta rufe. Inshorar gidan tana biyan replacement cost, deductible $1,000 ne, kuma iyakar gidan $250,000 ce. Ku rubuta abin da kamfanin inshora zai biya da abin da mai gidan zai biya. (Amsa: kamfanin inshora $17,000; mai gida $1,000.)
Yanzu za ku iya bambance inshorar dukiya da ta alhaki, da lissafin da'awar gwaji mai depreciation, deductible da iyakoki.

check.q: Don atisaye kawai: TV yana kai $900 sabo kuma ya rage daraja $300. Nawa ne actual cash value ɗinsa?
check.why: Actual cash value shi ne replacement cost a cire depreciation: $900 - $300 = $600.

check.q: Wani abokin ciniki ya ji wa direban kawo kaya rauni a gida ba da gangan ba, kuma an kai shi ƙara. Wace inshora ce za ta biya?
check.why: Inshorar alhaki tana biyan wasu idan doka ta ce mai inshora ne ke da alhakin cutar da su.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Dokokin gaskiya da shirinku na karatu da jarabawa
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Gane rashin gaskiya wajen sayarwa da rubuta shirin karatu da jarabawa mai ranaku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku wani yanayi na sayarwa ko hidima, za ku iya gane ayyukan rashin gaskiya ko na saɓa wa doka da zaɓar abin da ke na gaskiya, kuna samun aƙalla yanayi 4 cikin 5 daidai. Ta amfani da matakan hukuma na jiharku da jadawalin jarabawa, za ku iya rubuta shirin karatu da jarabawa mai ranaku don jarabawar lasisinku, wanda ya ƙunshi kowane mataki na hukuma, kowane batu na jadawalin da aƙalla ranaku biyu na jarabawar gwaji.
Jihohi suna da dokokin hana rashin gaskiya a kasuwanci (unfair trade practices), kuma kowace jarabawa tana gwada su. Misrepresentation ita ce yin ƙarya ko ɓoye abin da policy ke yi. Twisting shi ne lallashin abokin ciniki ya canja policy da ƙarya ko kwatanci mai ruɗi, har ya cutu. Churning shi ne canja policies akai-akai musamman don samun sabbin komishan. Rebating shi ne ba da wani sashe na komishan ɗinku ko kyauta don samun ciniki; ya saɓa wa doka a jihohi da yawa, don haka ku duba dokar jiharku. Premium da kuka karɓa na abokin ciniki da kamfanin inshora ne: wakili yana riƙe shi a matsayin amana (fiduciary duty) kuma kada ya haɗa shi da kuɗinsa na kansa (commingling).
Abin da ke na gaskiya mai sauƙi ne: ku faɗi gaskiya game da abin da inshora ta rufe, ku sa bukatun abokin ciniki a gaba, ku kwatanta policies da adalci, ku rubuta abubuwa, kuma ku ware kuɗin premium. Idan ba ku tabbata ba, ku tambayi manajanku ko ofishin jiha.
Yanzu ku yi shiri. Ku yi amfani da jadawalin jarabawa na jiharku don lissafa kowane batu da yawan tambayoyinsa. Ku ba batutuwa masu nauyi ƙarin kwanakin karatu. Ku sa ranar jarabawa da kuke nufi, ranaku biyu ko fiye na jarabawar gwaji da makin da kuke son samu. Ku gama duk kwas ɗin kafin lasisi da ake buƙata kafin ku yi rajistar jarabawa. Ku karanta kowace tambayar jarabawa sau biyu kuma ku lura da kalmomi kamar EXCEPT (sai dai) da NOT (ba).
Aikin ƙarshe: ku rubuta Shirinku na Karatu da Jarabawa na shafi ɗaya mai nau'in lasisinku, matakan hukuma na jiharku da adireshin shafukansu, batutuwan jadawalin da nauyinsu, jadawalin mako-mako mai ranaku, ranakun jarabawar gwaji, da'awar gwaji uku da dokokin gaskiya uku.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku lissafa matakan hukuma na jiharku bi da bi da adireshin shafukansu.
- Ku kwafi kowane batu na jadawalin da yawan tambayoyinsa.
- Ku ba batutuwan da ke da tambayoyi mafi yawa ƙarin kwanakin karatu.
- Ku zaɓi ranar jarabawa da kuke nufi da aƙalla ranaku biyu na jarabawar gwaji tare da makin da kuke son samu.
- Ku ƙara da'awar gwaji uku da dokokin gaskiya uku da kalmominku.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Misrepresentation: yin ƙarya ko ɓoye abin da policy ke yi ko kuɗinta.
- Twisting: amfani da ƙarya ko kwatanci mai ruɗi don sa abokin ciniki ya canja policy.
- Churning: canja policies akai-akai musamman don samun komishan.
- Rebating: mayar da wani sashe na komishan ko ba da kyauta don samun ciniki; ya saɓa wa doka a jihohi da yawa.
- Fiduciary (mai amana): mutumin da aka amince masa ya kula da kuɗin wani da gaskiya.
- Commingling: haɗa kuɗin premium na abokin ciniki da kuɗinku na kanku.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- NAIC Model Law 880: Dokar Hana Rashin Gaskiya a Kasuwanci (Unfair Trade Practices Act)
- NAIC: Nemo ofishin inshora na jiharku
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku rubuta Shirinku na Karatu da Jarabawar Lasisin Inshora a shafi ɗaya, ta amfani da matakan hukuma da jadawalin jarabawa na jiharku, da ranaku na gaske ga kowane makon karatu, jarabawar gwaji biyu da ranar jarabawa da kuke nufi.
Yanzu za ku iya gane rashin gaskiya wajen sayarwa, zaɓar abin da ke na gaskiya, da bin shirin karatu da jarabawa mai ranaku don jarabawar lasisinku.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Nau'in lasisi daidai Ba a ambaci nau'in lasisi ba, ko an ambaci wanda bai dace da aikin ba. Ya ambaci nau'in lasisin da ya dace da aikin kuma ya faɗi dalili. Ya kuma ambaci nau'i na biyu ko wani lasisi da mai koyo zai iya buƙata daga baya da dalili. Matakan hukuma Matakai sun ɓace ko sun fito daga talla ko abokai. Kowane mataki daga shafin hukuma na jihar, bi da bi, da adireshin shafuka. Ya ƙara ranar da aka duba, littafin jagora na kamfanin jarabawa da duk wani matakin binciken tarihi. Batutuwan jadawali da kalmomi Babu batutuwan jadawali, ko an yi bayanin manyan kalmomi ba daidai ba. Ya lissafa kowane batu na jadawalin da nauyinsa kuma ya yi bayanin manyan kalmomi daidai. Ya nuna batutuwan da mai koyo ya fi rauni a kai kuma ya ƙara katunan tunawa don su. Da'awar gwaji Da'awa ƙasa da uku, ko amsoshi ba daidai ba. Da'awar gwaji uku da aka lissafa daidai, ana nuna kowane mataki. Da'awar sun haɗa da deductible, coinsurance da iyakar inshora, kowanne da dubawar lissafin. Dokokin gaskiya Dokoki sun ɓace ko ba daidai ba. Dokokin gaskiya uku da aka yi bayani daidai da kalmomin mai koyo. Kowace doka tana da ɗan misali na abin da ke na gaskiya. Shiri mai ranaku Babu ranaku, ko babu jarabawar gwaji. Jadawalin mako-mako mai ranaku, ranar jarabawa da ake nufi da jarabawar gwaji biyu tare da makin da ake son samu. Ƙarin kwanakin karatu sun tafi ga batutuwan jadawalin mafi nauyi, tare da ranar jarabawa ta ajiya. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.
